external_source_fact.rule: SPOT timestamps from 2025-01-01 onwards are in microseconds
external_source_fact.selection_basis: provider documentation only; no outcome inspection

normalization.before_2025_01_01: interpret open_time and close_time as milliseconds
normalization.from_2025_01_01: interpret open_time and close_time as microseconds
normalization.open_time_ms: for microsecond rows require source open_time divisible by 1000, then integer-divide by 1000
normalization.source_close_time_audit: audit close_time in source units against source_open_time + 900000000 - 1 for 15m microsecond rows; pre-2025 audit remains source_open_time + 900000 - 1
